mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 2.5% for 2 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand that drives corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods with HOUST and RSAFS both rising >1% monthly, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 150,000 per month signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods with UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 150k, or Rank IC for PAYEMS signal < 0.03 in this regime.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output that correlates with stronger corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods with rising INDPRO, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,100,000 units for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods with HOUST < 1100 for 2 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates coordinated monetary and labor market stimulus that boosts economic growth and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods with both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE declining, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% for two consecutive quarters), a slowdown in GDP growth (GDPC1 growth < 2.0%) signals an impending economic deceleration that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods with GDPC1 growth < 2.0% in late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC for slowdown signal < 0.03 in this regime.
